rewrites.comment: Single-page app: every path must serve index.html so React Router can handle it. Without this, only '/' works — /schedule, /teams and /standings all 404 on refresh, on a bookmark, and for Googlebot. Vercel checks the filesystem BEFORE rewrites, so real files (/robots.txt, /sitemap.xml, /assets/*) are still served directly.

headers.comment: Hashed filenames change whenever the content does, so they can be cached forever.
The HTML shell must never be cached hard, or a deploy leaves visitors on a stale bundle.
